![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Since only one patch file is being applied now, you can simplify this by using input redirection instead of `cat` and a pipe. This is more efficient as it avoids spawning an extra `cat` process.

```suggestion
    patch -d /usr/lib/osbuild -p1 < /usr/lib/coreos-assembler/0002-stages-extend-to-find-EFI-under-usr-lib-efi.patch
```
